title: 第7章 蝼蚁挑衅抬手碾压第8章 谣言四起静待风雨
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 葬神墓园的阴风刺骨冰凉，卷着满地细碎的枯尘与煞气，在荒芜坟冢间穿梭呼啸。浓稠的黑雾沉沉压落，将整片山谷包裹得密不透风，视野不过丈余，处处透着死寂与阴森。寻常修士踏入此地，心神都会被怨念侵染，更别说在其中存活三日之久。
两名外门杂役弟子踏着碎石，慢悠悠走入墓园外围，脸上挂着毫不掩饰的戏谑笑意。在他们心中，林寂早已是一具冰冷的残尸，今日过来巡查，不过是走个过场，顺带找找乐子，回去也好在前山同门面前吹嘘一番。
左边一名瘦脸弟子手持清扫尘拂，漫不经心地拨开身前飘荡的黑雾，嘴角撇着讥讽：“说实话，我当初还以为这废物能撑个四五天，没想到连赵师兄的半月之期都熬不过，真是没用至极。”
右侧微胖弟子更是肆无忌惮，抬脚踢飞脚边一块碎石，碎石滚落坟坑，发出空洞的声响。“朽体就是朽体，天生注定是废物。三年苦修装模作样，到头来还不是死得悄无声息，连块完整尸骨都留不下。”
两人你一言我一语，刻薄的话语在空旷死寂的墓园里回荡，格外刺耳。他们早已习惯了欺凌弱小、追捧天才，当初林寂未被宣判朽体时，便时常被二人暗中排挤嘲弄，如今对方落魄绝境，自然要落井下石，尽情踩踏。
二人边走边四处张望，目光扫过遍地断碑荒坟，试图寻找林寂残留的衣物残骸。可视线所及，只有漫天黑雾、嶙峋乱石与腐朽坟土，连半点人影痕迹都没有。
“奇怪，怎么一点痕迹都没有？”瘦脸弟子皱眉低语，心底掠过一丝诧异。
“能有什么痕迹？大概率是被噬煞兽啃得干干净净，连碎布都不剩了。”微胖弟子嗤笑一声，全然没有放在心上，随即目光扫向前方那尊矗立的无字断碑，视线骤然定格，“等等，那是什么？”
浓稠黑雾之中，一道清瘦的身影静静端坐碑顶。
少年身着洗得发白的破旧弟子服，身姿挺拔安稳，周身没有半点灵光波动，看起来平平无奇，如同一尊静置的石像，沉寂在黑雾阴风之中。
正是他们认定早已身死道消的林寂。
刹那间，两名杂役弟子脸上的笑容瞬间僵住，眼底的戏谑尽数褪去，取而代之的是满脸惊愕与难以置信。
“怎、怎么可能？！”
瘦脸弟子瞳孔骤缩，失声低呼，“他居然还活着？在葬神墓园待了整整三天，一点伤都没有？”
他们无比清楚这片死地的恐怖，别说朽体废人，就算是内门凝气修士，在此驻守三日，也必然煞气侵体、身受重创。可林寂端坐碑上，气息平稳，身形挺拔，看起来除了衣着破旧，竟毫无异常。
短暂的震惊过后，两人心底的诧异迅速被浓浓的不屑与恼怒取代。
一个被宗门彻底抛弃的朽体废物，苟活在绝境之中，凭什么安然无恙？
微胖弟子脸色一沉，跨步上前，抬手指向碑顶的林寂，语气凶狠刻薄：“林寂，你命倒是够硬！区区废体，也配在这墓园苟活？看来三日煞气没能磨死你，是你运气太好了！”
“滚下来！”
他厉声呵斥，姿态傲慢至极，全然没把林寂放在眼里，“杂役守坟，本该跪地履职，你竟敢盘踞墓碑、慵懒懈怠，当真不知规矩！”
在他们看来，林寂早已不是宗门弟子，只是一个低贱的守坟杂役，他们身为巡查弟子，身份远高于对方，随意呵斥拿捏，理所应当。
碑顶之上，林寂缓缓抬眼。
漆黑的眼眸平静无波，没有愤怒，没有波澜，只有一片看透蝼蚁闹剧的漠然。三日苦修，他脱胎换骨，修为抵达引气巅峰，肉身强悍远超常人，早已不是这两个区区外门杂役可以招惹的存在。
他懒得废话，只是淡淡注视着二人拙劣的跳梁小丑行径。
林寂的沉默，在两名弟子眼中，成了懦弱畏惧、不敢反抗的表现。
瘦脸弟子见状，底气更盛，冷笑着上前几步，眼底满是阴狠：“怎么？当了三天守坟鬼，胆子也跟着变小了？之前在大典上不是挺能嘴硬的吗？现在怎么不敢说话了？”
content_en:
The cold wind in the God Burial Cemetery is biting and cold, carrying fine dust and evil spirits all over the ground, whistling between the desolate tombs. The thick black mist fell heavily, covering the entire valley so airtight that the field of vision was no more than ten feet away, and there was deathly silence and gloominess everywhere. When an ordinary monk steps into this place, his mind will be infected with resentment, let alone survive in it for three days.
The two outer sect servant disciples stepped on the gravel and slowly walked into the periphery of the cemetery, with undisguised joking smiles on their faces. In their hearts, Lin Ji was already a cold corpse. Today's inspection was just a formality to have some fun and brag about it in front of his fellow disciples in the front mountain.
A thin-faced disciple on the left held a dust whisk and casually pushed away the black mist floating in front of him, with a sarcastic expression on his lips: "To be honest, I thought this piece of trash could last for four or five days, but I didn't expect that it couldn't even survive the half-month period of Senior Brother Zhao. It's really useless."
The fat disciple on the right was even more unscrupulous. He raised his foot and kicked away a piece of gravel beside his feet. The gravel rolled down into the grave pit, making a hollow sound. "A rotten body is a rotten body, and it is destined to be waste. After three years of hard work and pretentiousness, in the end, it died quietly, not even a complete skeleton was left."
The two of them were talking to each other, and their harsh words echoed in the empty and silent cemetery, which was particularly harsh. They have long been accustomed to bullying the weak and pursuing geniuses. When Lin Ji was not sentenced to death, he was often secretly ostracized and ridiculed by the two. Now that the other party is in a desperate situation, it is natural to add insult to injury and trample on him to his heart's content.
The two of them looked around as they walked, scanning the ruined graves all over the place, trying to find the remains of Lin Ji's clothes. As far as the eye can see, there is only black fog, jagged rocks and decaying grave soil, not even the slightest trace of human beings.
"Strange, why are there no traces at all?" The thin-faced disciple frowned and whispered, a trace of surprise passing through his heart.
"What traces can there be? Most likely it was eaten clean by the evil-eating beast, not even rags are left." The fat disciple sneered, not taking it to heart at all, and then glanced at the wordless monument standing in front of him, his eyes suddenly froze, "Wait, what is that?"
In the thick black fog, a thin figure sat quietly on the top of the monument.
The young man was dressed in a shabby disciple uniform that had been washed white, and his posture was straight and steady. There was no spiritual light fluctuation around his body. He looked ordinary, like a still stone statue, silent in the black mist and wind.
It was Lin Ji who they believed to be dead long ago.
In an instant, the smiles on the faces of the two handyman disciples suddenly froze, and all the amusement in their eyes faded away, replaced by faces filled with shock and disbelief.
"How, how is it possible?!"
The thin-faced disciple's pupils shrank suddenly and he whispered, "He is actually still alive? He stayed in the God Burial Cemetery for three whole days and he didn't get any injuries at all?"
They are very aware of the horror of this death place. Not to mention the decayed bodies and disabled people, even the inner sect Qi Condensation monks who stay here for three days will definitely have the evil spirit invade their bodies and suffer serious injuries. But Lin Ji was sitting on the monument, his breathing was steady, his figure was tall and straight, and he looked like there was nothing unusual except for his shabby clothes.
After a brief shock, the surprise in the two people's hearts was quickly replaced by deep disdain and anger.
A rotten waste who was completely abandoned by the sect and lived in a desperate situation, how could he be safe and sound?
The fat disciple's face darkened, he stepped forward, raised his hand and pointed at Lin Ji on the top of the monument, and said in a fierce and mean tone: "Lin Ji, your life is quite tough! How can a mere waste body deserve to live in this cemetery? It seems that three days of evil energy did not kill you, it is because you are so lucky!"
"Get off!"
He scolded sternly, his attitude was extremely arrogant, and he didn't take Lin Ji seriously at all. "The handyman is guarding the grave. He should kneel down to perform his duties. How dare you sit on the tombstone and be lazy? You really don't know the rules!"
In their view, Lin Ji was no longer a disciple of the sect, but just a lowly grave guard. As patrolling disciples, their status was much higher than that of the other party, so they could scold him at will, which was natural.
On top of the monument, Lin Ji slowly raised his eyes.
The dark eyes were calm and calm, with no anger or waves, only the indifference that had seen through the ants' farce. After three days of hard training, he was reborn, his cultivation reached the peak of Qi Entrainment, and his physical strength was far beyond that of ordinary people. He was no longer someone that these two mere outsiders could mess with.
He was too lazy to talk nonsense and just watched the two people's clumsy clown behavior.
Lin Ji's silence, in the eyes of the two disciples, became a sign of cowardice and fear, not daring to resist.
Seeing this, the thin-faced disciple became more confident. He sneered and took a few steps forward. His eyes were full of sinisterness: "What? After three days of being a grave-guarding ghost, my courage has also become smaller. Weren't you quite tough-talking in the ceremony before? Why don't you dare to speak now?"
title_en: Chapter 7: The ants raise their hands to challenge and crush Chapter 8: Rumors spread and wait for the storm
